description: Failure scenarios tested for GNOME system-bus flows

failures_tested.name: daemon_unavailable_shows_error_and_recovery
failures_tested.scenario: Daemon down (Mode::DaemonDown) → refresh shows error + recovery hint
failures_tested.expected: Error with recovery guidance, no profiles listed

failures_tested.name: polkit_denied_shows_auth_error
failures_tested.scenario: Polkit denial on start_enrollment → authentication error shown
failures_tested.expected: Error with admin-approval recovery hint, no enrollment started

failures_tested.name: low_diversity_shows_guidance
failures_tested.scenario: Low-diversity capture → quality 'low' → guidance shown; commit fails
failures_tested.expected: Guidance alert, enrollment cleared on failed commit, error surfaced

failures_tested.name: duplicate_profile_name_surfaces_exists
failures_tested.scenario: start_enrollment with existing name → Exists error
failures_tested.expected: Error containing 'exists' or 'already', no enrollment started

failures_tested.name: cancel_mid_enrollment_cleans_up
failures_tested.scenario: Cancel during enrollment → session cleaned up, no profile persisted
failures_tested.expected: Enrollment cleared, cancel message, no profile in store

failures_tested.name: reconnect_restores_state
failures_tested.scenario: Daemon down → error; daemon up → full state restored
failures_tested.expected: Profiles, PAM services, protection status all restored after reconnect
